business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Technocrats Plasma Systems Limited is an engineering-led manufacturer of plasma cutting machines, welding equipment and customised automation systems for metal fabrication and related industries in India. Its products are used by customers across automotive, construction, shipbuilding, heavy engineering and general manufacturing sectors, and its activities span system configuration, detailed engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, installation/commissioning support and after-sales service and spares.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Machines (without automation):** Manual plasma cutters (inverter, thyristor/diode, hybrid technology), MMA welding power sources, MIG/MAG welding power sources, TIG welding power sources, SAW welding power sources
- **Machines (with automation):** CNC plate profile cutting systems (plasma/oxyfuel), CNC pipe profile cutting systems (plasma/oxyfuel), Laser cutting systems, Laser welding systems, Welding automation cells, Combined cutting and welding cells

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Automotive
- Construction
- Shipbuilding
- Heavy engineering
- General manufacturing

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Currently dependent on external suppliers for raw materials and certain precision components, without long-term supply agreements or fixed terms of trade with most suppliers (top 10 suppliers contributed 93.50% of purchases in FY26, 93.12% in FY25, 43.63% in FY24). IPO capex (per Objects of the Offer) is aimed at augmenting production capacity and is expected to reduce dependence on external vendors for certain precision components, with in-house production of critical components and tooling expected to improve cost efficiencies and operating margins. Company operates a business-to-business (B2B) model supplying cutting, welding and automation equipment to fabrication shops, OEMs and industrial customers across heavy fabrication/engineering, automotive/auto components, infrastructure/construction equipment, shipbuilding, steel service centres and process industries; customers span 22 states and 2 countries. Revenue from repeat orders vs. new customers: FY26 Rs.2,48,311 thousand repeat / Rs.10,64,778 thousand new customers (total Rs.13,13,090 thousand); FY25 Rs.1,36,698 thousand repeat / Rs.3,56,870 thousand new (total Rs.4,93,568 thousand); FY24 Rs.55,231 thousand repeat / Rs.5,392 thousand new (total Rs.60,623 thousand).

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Current product development is focused on laser cutting and welding solutions.
- Enhancing the automation readiness of systems to enable customers to adopt higher levels of process control and integration.

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Company intends to strengthen its manufacturing base at the Existing Premises (Unit-I and Unit-II at Gaodevi Industrial Estate, Sativali, Vasai East) using IPO Net Proceeds to purchase and install additional plant and machinery for manufacturing plasma cutting machines, welding equipment and customised automation systems.

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body: - Customer concentration — Top 10 customers accounted for 62.61% of revenue from operations in FY26 (83.89% in FY25, 55.70% in FY24); loss of, or reduced demand from, key customers would significantly adversely impact business and results of operations.

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Utilise IPO Net Proceeds to purchase and install plant and machinery for manufacturing plasma cutting machines, welding equipment and customised automation systems at the Existing Premises (Unit-I and Unit-II, Sativali, Vasai East).**
- **Utilise IPO Net Proceeds towards funding long-term working capital requirements.**
- **Utilise balance IPO Net Proceeds for general corporate purposes.**
- **Current product development is focused on laser cutting and welding solutions and on enhancing the automation readiness of the company's systems, enabling customers to adopt higher levels of process control and integration.**
- **Substantial portion of revenue from operations is derived from top 10 customers; loss of, or reduced business from, such customers would have a significant adverse impact on business and results of operations.**
